title: Glowing submarine
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Submarine body - bright yellow with lighter highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='35' ry='16' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='53' rx='35' ry='14' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <!-- Inner body shading -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='30' ry='11' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <!-- Conning tower / sail -->
  <rect x='38' y='33' width='20' height='14' rx='3' fill='#FFB800'/>
  <rect x='40' y='35' width='16' height='10' rx='2' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <!-- Periscope -->
  <rect x='46' y='22' width='4' height='12' rx='1' fill='#FFB800'/>
  <rect x='46' y='22' width='8' height='3' rx='1' fill='#FFE66D'/>
  <!-- Portholes -->
  <circle cx='35' cy='55' r='5' fill='#4DD9FF'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='55' r='3' fill='#A8EEFF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='5' fill='#4DD9FF'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='3' fill='#A8EEFF'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='55' r='5' fill='#4DD9FF'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='55' r='3' fill='#A8EEFF'/>
  <!-- Propeller -->
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='55' rx='3' ry='10' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <ellipse cx='85' cy='55' rx='10' ry='3' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='55' r='3' fill='#FFB366'/>
  <!-- Tail fin -->
  <polygon points='80,44 90,38 88,48' fill='#FFB800'/>
  <polygon points='80,66 90,72 88,62' fill='#FFB800'/>
  <!-- Glow effect around submarine -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='40' ry='21' fill='none' stroke='#FFF176' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.4'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='44' ry='24' fill='none' stroke='#FFF176' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.2'/>
  <!-- Bubbles -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='40' r='3' fill='#4DD9FF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='22' cy='32' r='2' fill='#4DD9FF' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='28' r='1.5' fill='#4DD9FF' opacity='0.4'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='44' r='2' fill='#4DD9FF' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
